title: The Third Plate
core_idea: The agonizing delay between the heart knowing someone is gone and the body's refusal to stop performing the rituals of their presence.
angle: Recognition through micro-traumas of domestic ritual — the kitchen, the grocery store, the third plate set without thinking. Approaches the source material via the body's refusal to stop performing rituals of presence after loss.
narrator_hint: A mother (Sanabel) who is the keeper of mundane habits, trapped in the 'muscle memory' of her household.
reasoning: Folk music excels at domestic intimacy and the small, sensory details of the home. The acoustic vulnerability allows the 'micro-traumas' of grocery shopping and plate-setting to take center stage without being overshadowed by heavy production.
